decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - It is considered that the proposed single-storey rear extension, two air-conditioning units and the installation of new shopfront, would be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics, would be compatible with the appearance of the building and the character of the streetscene, and would not harm the viability of the adjoining businesses or the living conditions of adjoining occupiers. The development is therefore in accordance with Unitary Development Plan policies (Adopted December 2003) ENV-B.1.1, S.1.2 and S.4.2.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the premises are used.

Condition : 5 - The access doorway to the betting shop shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level.

Condition : 6 - The air-conditioning units hereby approved should not cause a combined increase in existing background noise levels in the area. To achieve this the the sytsem should be 10dB below existing background noise levels when operating at its maximum.
description: Demolition of existing rear timber structure and erection of single storey rear extension, installation of new shop front and installation of two air conditioning unit to flat roof of rear extension
